definitions.gloss: royal family; royal house; royal household
definitions.explanation: The family of a king or queen; a reigning dynasty. Used primarily for foreign monarchies rather than the Japanese imperial family.

examples.japanese: ⟦イギリス→イギリス：28283_igirisu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{王室|おうしつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The British royal family is popular.

examples.japanese: {王室|おうしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界中|せかいじゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{中継|ちゅうけい}→中継：11306_chuukei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The royal wedding was broadcast around the world.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{王室|おうしつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{何百年|なんびゃくねん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}ち→持つ：00478_motsu⟧、⟦{国民|こくみん}→国民：02757_kokumin⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{深|ふか}く→深い：01211_fukai⟧⟦{敬|うやま}われている→敬う：00417_uyamau⟧。
examples.english: That country's royal family has a history of hundreds of years and is deeply revered by the people.

notes:
USAGE:
{王室|おうしつ} refers to royal families of countries with kings and queens. For the Japanese imperial family, the word ⟦{皇室|こうしつ}→皇室：11339_koushitsu⟧ is used instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {王室|おうしつ}⟦{外交|がいこう}→外交：02627_gaikou⟧ (royal diplomacy)
- {王室|おうしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一員|いちいん}→一員：08920_ichiin⟧ (a member of the royal family)
- {王室|おうしつ}{御用達|ごようたし} (purveyor to the royal household)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{皇室|こうしつ}→皇室：11339_koushitsu⟧ is used exclusively for the Japanese imperial family. ⟦{王家|おうけ}→王家：13548_ouke⟧ (royal house) is a synonym but more literary. ⟦{王族|おうぞく}→王族：13587_ouzoku⟧ refers to individual members of a royal family.
